notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Skullwinder.
description:
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the token Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
